Commentary.Commentary: That's all we have to offer from this game. The Indians have dominated the South Africans like they do when playing at home. Spin, strangely, has been the talk of this limited overs series. The home side batsmen seem like treading on fire when facing spin. There are three more games in this ODI series left. They would now treat this as a three-match series. AB de Villiers is expected to be back though only time will confirm the same. Will the story be same even then? Remember, the 4th one is the Pink ODI. It will be played on the 10th of February, 2018 at the Wanderers in Johannesburg at 1300 local time (1100 GMT). See ya then. Adios, take care!

Virat Kohli, the winning captain, is also the Man of the Match. He says that although he didn't start off well, he knew he had to stick it out in the middle for his side to get to a good total. States that the new ball was coming onto the bat nicely. Adds that after 30 overs, the track slowed down considerably due to which they had to adjust their target accordingly. Mentions that it is pleasing to lead from the front. Credits Shikhar Dhawan for his innings. Lauds Bhuvneshwar Kumar's efforts with the bat as well. States that he battled cramps when he was in the 90s. Iterates that when the wrist spinners land it in the right areas, they get rewarded. Adds further that this was a surface touted to not favour them yet they have done well to pick up 8 between them. Talks about maintaining the intensity in the further games even after knowing that the Proteas can't come back to win the series.

Time for the presentation. Aiden Markram, the losing skipper, is first up. He reckons that this was a very disappointing outing yet again. Credits Virat Kohli and the opposition spinners for their exploits. States that they were always in the game when on the field. Says that the final target was a gettable one but laments the batting failure yet again for the loss. Mentions that the opposing spinners are of a very good quality and hence, even after three outings they are on the wrong side of things. Is hopeful of AB de Villiers returning in the next game.

Picture this. South Africa's team total is just 19 runs more than what Virat Kohli managed. Dominance is writ large here. This game meted out in a similar fashion to that of the female counterparts. There, a certain Smriti Mandhana, wearing jersey no.18, stroked her way to a century. Here, a certain Virat Kohli with the same number on the back of his t-shirt, did that. It was a magnanimous win there and so it is here. A wrist spinner, Poonam Yadav, picked up a four-fer in that game, while here, we had two doing the same.

However, Markram's fall opened the floodgates and then wickets came falling like water from an open tap. Only Khaya Zondo and David Miller stayed in the middle for a considerable time. But then, nobody seemed to have answers to what Yuzvendra Chahal and Kuldeep Yadav were throwing at them. The latter got his first ODI four-fer in the process. Jasprit Bumrah did his I-am-present-teacher thing by picking up a couple of useful scalps.

A sense of deja vu gets to us as we have a look at the way the game panned. 18-1-69-8 read the combined figures of the spin twins. Rest assured, there is no further confirmation needed as to who were the wreckers-in-chief for the tourists. South Africa started poorly losing Hashim Amla pretty early. But Aiden Markram and Jean-Paul Duminy set about with their tasks in right earnest. They stitched together a 78-run stand, which was the only one over 50 for the hosts.

OUT! How silent was this wicket! Dhoni told Kuldeep to bowl the other one and he does. Lands it on middle and gets it to turn away. Ngidi swipes across the line but misses the ball completely. The players don't even bother appealing. The umpire raises the finger. Hold on, Hawk Eye shows the ball to be PASSING OVER THE STUMPS. The hosts didn't have any review left, though. INDIA WIN BY 124 RUNS AND TAKE AN UNASSAILABLE 3-0 LEAD IN THE SERIES!

FOUR! Yadav comes round the wicket and tosses this up. Lungi goes with the spin and hits it over mid-wicket. The ball lands just in front of the ropes, the fielder after it signals that to the umpire but it's still given as a biggie. Then he goes upstairs to find that the ball indeed bounced before the rope. Umpire Adrian Holdstock corrects his mistake.
A flatter googly outside off, Ngidi misses it completely.
A low full toss outside off, just clears mid off. Gets a couple for that.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Tossed up around middle, Lungi lunges to turn but misses to get hit on the pads. The players appeal to no avail.
Flatter on middle and leg, Rabada looks to block but gets a leading edge to the off side.

SIX! Ho, ho, ho... it's a beauty! Flighted ball around middle, Rabada gets down on a knee and goes with the spin. Makes nice contact as the ball clears the deep mid-wicket fence with ease. Just the second six off this innings.
Debutant Lungi Ngidi is the last man in.

OUT! The party has ended. Chahal is not afraid to toss it up yet again. Tahir gets down on a knee to slog it out of Cape Town but fails to even clear the 30-yard circle. Finds Kohli at mid on with the skier. This is Chahal's fourth wicket.
The batsman fails to put bat on ball.

FOUR! The best shot from a South African in this innings has come from the no.10, quips my partner. Tahir dances down to this tossed up ball and hits it straight over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Flatter on the pads, turned through square leg for one.
Googly outside off, Imran is some years away from picking that. Misses it and MS whips off the bails but the batsman's back foot is firmly grounded.
Floated around off and middle, Imran looks to turn it to the on side but gets a leading edge towards point.
FOUR! Nice way to get off the mark. A low full toss outside off, Tahir reaches out to that and drives it square on the off side. The ball has enough in it to go to the fence.
Imran Tahir walks out next.

OUT! Ever heard a strict mother warning her ward to not accept lollipops from strangers? Such an instruction should be given to the South African batsmen as well. Yadav tosses this up nicely outside off, Phehlukwayo fails to resist the temptation to go after that. Looks to hoick it over the on side but gets a top edge. Kohli runs forward from covers and accepts it gleefully. India need another 2 wickets to be 3-0 at the end of this game.
Flatter and quicker on off, Andile goes back to cut but is lucky to slice it towards point.
Floated up full around off, Andile gets down and plays the reverse sweep. Gets it towards third man for a couple.
FOUR! How did that miss the stumps? Floated up around middle and leg, the ball spins in sharply. Rabada looks to drive that but gets an inside edge past the stumps for a boundary.
This ball is punched through covers for one.
Yuzvendra comes back over the wicket and serves it around leg. Kagiso sweeps it through square leg for a single.
Beauty. Tossed up ball from outside off, Rabada strides forward to defend but gets beaten on the inside.
Chahal comes round the wicket and lands it around off, wristed away to mid-wicket.

OUT! My partner here, Praky, wonders if Kohli had held his spinners back just to get some night allowance. He had the chance to go for the kill earlier but he didn't. Now he has brought both of them back and each has struck. Chahal tosses this one up around off, Zondo gets down to slog it away. Gets a top edge, the ball goes up, touches eternity and comes down to Pandey, the sub, at covers. As easy as it gets. The end is nigh for the hosts now. Third wicket for Yuzvendra.
Yuzvendra Chahal is back as well.
Lovely. Lands around off, Phehlukwayo goes back to defend. The ball just spins away to square him up completely.
Floated outside off, driven to covers.
This ball is reverse swept to point.
Flatter delivery, it goes straight on after pitching. Phehlukwayo fails to pick it up. The ball just passes over the stumps.
Andile Phehlukwayo is the next batter in.

OUT! As plumb as it gets. Morris is done with playing his shot during breakfast while the ball is served for lunch. He gets across the stumps and wears it on the box as he missed his pull. An appeal is just a formality as the finger is raised immediately. 154 off 88 needed as Chris walks back vigorously shaking his head. Not sure if it is because of him missing the ball completely or if someone from the opposite camp had something to say to him.
Wrong 'un on the pads to start, Khaya gets down and sweeps it to fine leg for one. 150 up for South Africa.
Kuldeep Yadav is back on. Is he here to hasten the end?
Short in length, pulled away to fine leg for one. 7 runs off the over.
This ball is blasted to long on for one.
Fuller in length at 113 kph, Morris looks to work it through the on side but gets it off the inner half towards fine leg for a brace.
This ball is pushed past backward point for one.
On a length outside off, Chris opens the face of the bat to guide it through point for one.
Full outside off, sliced over covers for one. Zondo always wanted a second but Morris wasn't on the same page.

Drinks! 162 more needed off 96 balls. South Africa are losing their way yet again. They lost the momentum when the spin twins came on and here they are, staring at yet another defeat. India, well, they are just a blow away from being 3-0 up. 5 more wickets to be taken. How long will it take? Do we have a twist in the tale? Hardik Pandya to run in now...
Khaya taps it to the off side and gets to the other end to face the first ball of the next over.
Short and wide, cut away to deep point for one.
This ball is hit straight to the man at covers.
On the pads yet again, flicked away through square leg for a brace.

FOUR! Shot. Talk about the followthrough of the blades and the extension of the arms and the presence of the high elbows... this shot had it all. Fuller ball outside off, Morris gets his front foot forward and drives it through covers. The mid off fielder ran to his right but couldn't do much once the ball passed him.
Length ball on the pads, flicked away to fine leg for one.
Tucked away through backward square leg for one. Successful over for Jasprit.
Fuller around middle and leg, wristed through mid-wicket for three.
Fuller around off, driven to covers.
Chris Morris strides out to bat next. Ability to take the side home, there. Can he do it?

OUT! This was always on the cards, wasn't it? Miller was fishing outside the off stump in the past couple of overs and now, although this isn't the same action, the edge is induced nevertheless. Bumrah runs in from round the wicket and delivers a length ball angling in to the batsman. David looks to pull it off the front foot. Wrongly positioned and a wrong choice of shot as well as the ball wasn't really short. What's more, he advanced down the track as well. All he managed to do was get an inside edge through to the keeper. That's that. The Indians appeal, get the umpire's nod and the southpaw doesn't even bother to wait. The Proteas still need 175 runs in just 105 balls.
Slanting in on a length, Khaya misses the flick. The ball rolls towards backward square leg and a leg bye is taken.
Fuller outside off, steered towards backward point.
On a length, flicked through mid-wicket. Pandya charges to the ball and returns a fairly quick throw but is unable to prevent the brace there. 176 more needed off 108 balls.
Miller has a feel for a length delivery angling away yet again. Misses.
This ball is driven through covers for a single.

Landed on a length around off and middle, Khaya looks to run as soon as he flicks it. Rohit from mid-wicket charges in and hits the stumps at the batter's end even as Zondo makes it in. The stumps light up although the bails don't come off. No run taken.
This ball is hit straight to the point fielder.
Full outside off, driven straight to the man at mid off.
Pandya was ready to bowl another over, but Kohli changes his mind. Decides to bring Bhuvneshwar Kumar on.
Outside off, pushed towards point.
144 kph reads the speedometer. Length ball around off, Miller hops but misses the tuck. Wears it high on the front pad. The Indians appeal to no avail.
Hurled fuller at 119 kph, David read that well and defended it back to the bowler.
Jasprit runs in from over the wicket, Miller comes down the track and punches it towards covers.
Fuller outside off, knocked to covers for one.
WIDE! Perhaps the seamers are trying to tuck Zondo up. In that pursuit, they are hurling deliveries on the pads or down the leg side. This one is sprayed down leg. Wided by the umpire.
Landed around middle and leg, turned away through mid-wicket for one.
Length ball slanting in, Zondo moves inside the line in a bid to flick it away but gets it off his thigh pads. Dhoni gets to his left and stops that.

Length ball around off at 142 kph. Zondo gets an inside edge onto the pads and the ball lands next to the pitch on the leg side. Pandya utters something on the lines of 'too quick for you..' to the batter as he goes to pick the ball up.
KZ defends this one off the back foot.

Short and wide, luckily for Pandya, it results in just two. Zondo camps back and cuts it aerially. The ball lands near the deep backward point fence as Pandey, the sub fielder, runs to his right from third man to do the mopping up job.
WIDE! Short and down the leg side, Zondo goes for the pull but misses. Wide signaled.
Fuller and around middle and leg, David works it away through square leg for one. Dhawan in the deep fumbles but doesn't concede an extra run.
Flashy! Won't help Miller. This one is hurled across the batter at 141 kph. The southpaw stands still and looks to flay it through the off side. Only makes contact with the thin air.
Played to the mid-wicket region by KZ.
Low full toss on middle, flicked away to mid-wicket.
This one is tucked away through square leg for a single.
FOUR! Streaky, Miller won't mind it. Banged short around leg, the southpaw swivels and pulls it. Gets a top edge through fine leg for a boundary.
Fuller this time, pushed away towards covers for nothing.
On a length going away, Miller stays back and slaps it past backward point for a brace.
Another change. Jasprit Bumrah is called up to bowl with some pace.
This one is guided through point to rotate strike.
Almost! Length ball slanting away from Miller, he has a poke at it only to get beaten by the finest of margins.
Length ball around middle and leg, Miller looks to work it to the on side. Gets a leading edge towards covers.
Angling away from the batsman, David stays back and keeps it out towards point.
On a length around middle and leg, Zondo looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball rolls to the on side and he gets a single.
Length ball on leg, nudged away to fine leg for one.
Hardik Pandya is back on.
Flighted ball on a fuller length, driven to long off to retain strike.
Fuller around middle and leg, flicked away to short fine leg.
Floated around off, Miller gets forward to defend but gets a soft edge towards slip.
DM is nicely forward with a lunge and keeps it out.
Tossed up around off and middle, David prods and blocks.
He picked him, oh he picked him, exclaims our statsman, Vic. Floated around off, Miller lunges and lets it go by withdrawing his bat.
Swept away through square leg for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Floated outside off, pushed back to the left of the bowler. Chahal cannot reach it with a dive and lets a single to be taken.
Around off, knocked through mid off to get to the other end.
Tossed up ball, Zondo comes down the track and drives it to long on for one.
Flatter on the pads, worked away through square leg for one.

Meanwhile, Kedar Jadhav has gone off the field. A groin niggle, reckons Shaun Pollock on air. We remember him flinching after fielding a ball at deep square leg after running there from fine leg earlier in the innings.
Yadav comes from around the wicket and pulls his length back a bit. It spins back in and Zondo goes on the back foot in defense.
Once again Khaya is on the front foot to a full ball and blocks it back.
This is better. Zondo lunges to a full ball around off and defends it.

Not a good idea, Zondo. He goes deep inside the crease to a full ball and blocks it at the last moment. Picking the spin from the pitch won't help. It won't give you enough time to react, Khaya. Get forward. Don't over-commit though.
Flighted and around off, Miller draws forward and drills his drive to long off for a single.
Jumps out of the crease and drives it uppishly back towards the bowler. Kuldeep dives to his left but fails to reach. It runs down to long off and they take a run.
This one is very full and on middle, it's worked through mid-wicket for a run.
Spinning away from the batsman, Zondo goes on the back foot and taps it wide of second slip.
Two slips in place for the right-hander.
Loopy and full around leg, Miller reverse sweeps it to point and takes a run.
Fuller and down the leg side, Miller eases it through square leg for a couple of runs.
Tossed up ball on off, Miller blocks it off his front leg.
Flighted and full on leg, Miller tries to flick but misses.
Allows the ball to spin back in and goes back in defense. Maiden!
This one is served full and wide outside off, Zondo drives but finds extra cover.
Another forward defense by Zondo. Don't think he is picking Kuldeep from his hand.
Gets forward to a full ball and defends.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Zondo has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Turning back into the batsman, Zondo leans to defend but it takes the inside edge and rolls to short fine leg for a run.
Khaya Zondo is the new batsman.

OUT! That's hitting leg and Duminy, the set batsman, has to depart. Body blow to South Africa's chances. Chahal has his second. Another traditional leg spinner has earned him a wicket. He lands it around off and gets it to spin back into the left-hander. Duminy stays back to flick it on the leg side but misses. It thuds him on the pads, they appeal and this time the umpire thinks a bit before lifting his finger. JP Duminy has a chat with his partner before taking the DRS. To the naked eye, we thought it could be missing or at the most clipping the leg stump but the Hawk Eye shows it to be hitting leg. The Indians are delighted. Once again they have the opportunity to run over the Proteas.
Shout for an lbw! Up goes the finger and JP Duminy reviews it. Spinning too much but is it missing leg?
Tossed up ball on middle, swept through square leg for a run.
Allows the ball to spin back in and works it through square leg for a couple.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Miller has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
The batsman has driven it through mid off.
Googly on middle, Miller inside edges it towards short fine leg.

25th ODI fifty for JP Duminy, gets one after 17 innings. Fuller and on middle, Duminy clips it a bit aerially towards backward square leg for a run. A good knock so far from him but his team needs more.
Gets on the front foot to a full ball and pushes it to covers.
Duminy has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
The batsman gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads.
A googly landing full around off, Miller fails to pick it as he draws forward to defend. It goes off the outside edge towards the slip region.
Gets back and punches it down the ground for a single.
Quicker one, full and on middle, 85 kph, it's flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
David Miller is the new batsman.

OUT! Trapped in front! Chahal also tastes blood. Ominous signs for the Proteas. Is this once again going the same way like the last ODI? A nicely tossed up leg spinner, landing on leg and spinning away to beat the bat of Klaasen. He is rapped on the back leg, they appeal and the finger goes up almost immediately. The debutant has a chat with his senior partner but Duminy advises against the use of DRS. Heinrich walks back and South Africa lose their third wicket.
Tossed up ball on off, driven back to the bowler.
Spin from both ends now. Yuzvendra Chahal is brought back into the attack.
Duminy has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery. Testing over.
Full and outside off, driven down through mid on for a run.
Kuldeep is just toying with the newcomer. Bowls a googly now, around off and it curls away from the batsman.
Beautifully bowled. Turning back into the batsman from outside off, Klaasen tries to force it through covers but gets an inside edge back towards the bowler.

FOUR! Unforced error in the field. Who is the culprit? It's Bhuvneshwar. Loopy and full outside off, Klaasen presses forward and drills it through the line. Kumar runs across to his right at the edge of mid off but dives over the ball and lets it through for a boundary.
Leans forward to a full ball outside off and drives it to covers.
A stifled appeal for an lbw! Duminy fails to work it around the corner and takes a blow on his pads. They appeal, rather mutedly, nothing from the umpire. Probably, it pitched outside leg.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. Two runs added to the total.
Goes back to hit it square of the wicket on the off side. Rahane makes a super stop at point.
Fuller and outside off, driven to mid off.
Gets off the mark, Klaasen. He goes on the back foot and punches it through covers for a single.
On the pads, helped through square leg for a run.
Another slower delivery, full and outside off, it's driven to mid off. Successful first over by Yadav!
Klaasen has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
This one spins the other way, Klaasen goes back again and punches it to covers.
Turning back into the right-hander, Klaasen goes back and defends it to the leg side.
Heinrich Klaasen, the debutant, arrives in the middle. A slip and leg slip in place.

OUT! 400th dismissal for MS Dhoni in ODIs! Kuldeep slows this up in the air and lands it full around middle. Markram fails to read the googly there as he walks forward to flick it on the leg side. But the ball spins away to beat the outside edge and Dhoni takes the bails off in a flash. The chinaman strikes almost immediately and South Africa will hope this has not opened the floodgates. End of a handy partnership too. 225 needed off 202 balls!
Slower in pace but flatter through the air, Duminy goes back and punches it to sweeper cover for one.
Kuldeep Yadav replaces Chahal in the attack.
Plays this one nice and late. Places it towards point and retains strike with a single.
A length ball around off, Duminy hits it down to mid on.
Slower delivery around off, on a good length, Duminy taps it down to point.
Fuller and in the line of the stumps, Duminy gets behind it and pushes it to the off side.
Short in length and outside off, Duminy gets on top of the bounce and steers it through point for a couple of runs.
Fullish and outside off, a good looking cover drive for one.

Jumps out of the crease to a full ball and forces it down to long on for a run. So far, so good against the spinners. We heard that in the build up to this game, they practiced a lot against wrist spinners in the net. Seems, it's working.
Duminy has driven it through mid off. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Slower through the air, full and around off, spinning back in a bit, Duminy gets forward and defends it calmly to the off side.
Gives the charge to take it on the full and hits it to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Gets on the front foot and drives it through mid off for a single.
Flighted around leg, eased down to long on for one.
FOUR! Nice shot! Markram stands back to a shortish ball and powers it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
This one cuts back into the batsman to cramp Duminy. It goes off his thigh pad to Dhoni.
Played to the point region by the batsman. No run.

Short in length on middle, Duminy cracks his pull shot through backward square leg and it runs away. Jadhav does an excellent job to stop it in the deep by sprinting across to his right. A couple taken and it seems Jadhav has hurt his left ankle in the process.
Short around off, Markram plays a controlled hook shot to fine leg for a run.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Flatter one, full around leg, Duminy fails to sweep and it goes off his pads to fine leg. They appeal and the batsmen cross. Given as a leg bye. Probably pitched outside leg too.
Floated ball on off, Duminy defends it off his front foot.
Edged! Didn't pick him there. A wrong 'un around off, Duminy plays for the leg spin and edges it past Dhoni and short third man. A couple taken.
Fires in a fuller length ball on middle, Markram plays it down to long on for a run.
Quicker full ball on off, a slider, pushed back to the bowler.
Duminy offers the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
A rising delivery around off, Markram goes on his toes and deflects it down to third man for a run.
Wicket to wicket line, on a length, Duminy stays back and taps it down just beside the pitch. Dhoni runs forward and across to his left to collect the ball and they cross for one.
Angles in a length ball on middle, it's punched from the back foot past the mid-wicket fielder for a run.
An off cutter, straighter in line, JP nudges it behind square leg and takes a single.
Play and a miss! Back of a length ball around off, angling away, Duminy tries to play the cross-batted shot but fails to connect.
Uses his feet to run down the track and forces it down to long on for one. 50-run stand comes up!
Duminy has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Sharp inward spin from around middle, Duminy fails to flick and is hit on the pads. Dhoni from behind the stumps shouts that the ball is spinning too much on its own and there is no need to try anything extra.
Gives this one some extra air but forgets to land it. It's a full toss on middle, Markram knocks it down to long on for a run. Applause from the crowd as 50 comes up for South Africa.
Flighted and on middle, Markram leans forward and defends.
Tossed up ball on middle, played in front of square leg for a run.
Powerplay 2 time. The field can relax now with a maximum of 4 fielders allowed outside the ring until the 40th over. Now comes the real test, it's spin time. Yuzvendra Chahal to bowl with a leg slip.
Goes on the back foot to cover the line and defends it back.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Ooohhh...Pandya runs his fingers over the ball and lets out a cutter around off. Markram reads it a bit late and while trying to keep it out, he gets an inside edge. The ball gets stuck between his legs before falling close to the stumps.

Almost a run out! Slower full ball outside off, Aiden pushes it to covers, straight towards the fielder and his partner still looks for a run. Rohit has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Would have been touch and go!
Full and around off, it's pushed off the front foot back to the bowler.
Good length ball on middle and off, Duminy gets it away from the inner portion of the bat to short fine leg. They cross for a single.
Hardik Pandya is into the attack now.
A little bit of room outside off, JP sends the ball for a walk at third man and collects a single. 7 runs from the over without taking any risk.
Another one which takes the inner side of the blade. Duminy was looking to drive through the line but ends up pushing it towards mid on.
On a length around off, Duminy sticks back to push through the line but gets it away from the inner half of the bat to mid-wicket.

FOUR! Cleverly done. Kumar once again bowls a length ball which is leaving the left-hander outside off. Duminy waits for it quietly inside the crease and at the last moment just runs it down to third man. The fielder is a bit square in the deep and he has no chance of cutting it off.
Shortish and on off, Markram punches it firmly to sweeper cover for a run.
Angling away from the southpaw, Duminy just guides it down to third man for a run. They are playing risk free cricket at the moment.

Good fielding! A back of a length ball around off, it's punched straight back past the bowler. Kuldeep runs across to his left from mid on and dives to parry it towards his skipper, who has come from mid off. They take a couple.
Slower delivery, on a fuller length outside off, Aiden drives it off his front foot to mid off.

On a length and angling into the batsman, Duminy wrists it in front of square leg and the fielder gives the chase from the circle. Jadhav also gets across to his right from fine leg to stop the ball near the fence. They take two and one for his weak throw.
This one jags back into the batsman from a length around off. Duminy gets cramped for room and takes a blow on his back leg.
Bumrah runs in from round the wicket with a wide first slip. He angles in a length ball around off, Duminy covers the line and defends it to the off side.
Good length delivery around off, Markram goes back and taps it wide of first slip. They cross for a run.
Once again it's full and on middle, Duminy plays it off his pads to mid-wicket.
Full and on middle and off, JP presents a straight bat in defense.
FOUR! Poor line with fine leg up inside the circle. Kumar errs and serves on the pads, Duminy deflects it past the fielder at 45 for a boundary.
Around off on a good length, it's played from the back foot to covers.
Good length ball on middle, Duminy glances it off his hips through square leg. Good enough for a couple of runs.
Shortish ball on off, Duminy stands tall and punches it to covers.

Miscommunication but no harm done. Good length delivery on off, Markram strokes it off his back leg to cover-point. The fielder there parries it towards covers and Duminy thinks about a single. He is sent back immediately as the fielder has a wild shy at his end.
Pitches it up and outside off, Markram times his off drive well but fails to place it better. Straight to mid off.
Fullish and outside off, Markram pushes it off his front foot to mid on.
Angles in a length ball on middle, it's defended off the back foot to the leg side.
A length ball on off, Markram defends it off his front foot to the off side.
Room on offer outside off, Aiden Markram runs it down to third man and runs back for the second run.
Fractionally short in length around off, JP punches it off his back foot to covers. 11 from the over, a good one for the Proteas!
Back of a length delivery on middle and off, Duminy goes on his toes and keeps it out off the toe end of the bat.
And that fielder straightaway comes into action. On a length outside off, it's steered through cover-point for one.
Third man comes up, cover drops back.

FOUR! Gorgeous! A length ball this time, outside off, Markram strides forward and drives it crisply through covers for a glorious boundary. If the last shot was more of a tennis forehand, this was a proper cricketing shot.
SIX! Skipper has cleared the rope here! This is an outstanding pitch for stroke making. Markram rocks back, fetches a short ball from outside off and clubs it over long on for a biggie.
Shortish and outside off, Markram taps it down to short third man.

FOUR! Beautiful shot! Bumrah overpitches it outside off, Duminy presses forward and caresses it past mid off's right. A dive was needed but it never came. Once it crossed the ring, it was always a boundary.
Once again it has been defended from the back foot by Duminy.
Good length ball on middle and off, defended off the back foot.

Stop, Chahal! Bumrah serves it short and outside off, JP stands back and blazes his pull shot across the line. It had boundary written all over it but the little man, Chahal dives to his left at mid-wicket to make an excellent stop.
This one is a little too full around off, Markram drives it off his front foot to mid off and immediately calls for a single. Duminy responds and it's completed with ease.
Full in length and outside off, Aiden is on the front foot as he defends it to the off side. Loud shout of nooo follows. He wants to be loud and clear in his calling.

That's a good shot but there is a man out in the deep. Good ploy this by the Indian skipper. Not giving away easy boundaries. A length ball outside off, a delightful looking cover drive by Markram but it results in only a run.
Sliding down the leg side, nudged away to fine leg for a run.
Shortish ball wide outside off, cut through point for a couple of runs.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and blocks it safely.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Length ball on middle, too straight in line, Duminy tucks it off his pads but finds the mid-wicket fielder.
Wait on, shouts Duminy, as Kumar runs in to bowl the delivery. Some disturbance behind the sightscreen, perhaps.
This is hurled outside off, kept out towards covers. Good start for Bumrah and India.
Length ball outside off, blocked to the off side.
Duminy drives it wide of mid off and quickly gets to the other end.
FOUR! Misdirected delivery, taken full toll of. Length ball on the pads, Duminy gets inside the line and nudges it fine down the leg side for his and his side's first boundary. Nice way to get going.
Fuller outside off, driven to mid off.
JP Duminy walks in one drop for the hosts. Can this promotion do him and his side a world of good? Remember, he had a good outing with the ball earlier today.

OUT! Bumrah strikes off his first delivery! Dream start for India with the ball. He runs in from over the wicket and lands it on a length around off. Amla hops to flick it away but misses and is caught right in front of the stumps. The Indians go up in appeal and get the nod from the umpire. Amla has a chat with his skipper at the other end, who says it isn't a good idea to review that. He is right there as the Hawk Eye returns three reds. The home side is jolted early in their run chase.
Jasprit Bumrah to bowl from the other end.
Kumar goes full this time, outside off, Markram drives but this time finds the mid off fielder. Tidy beginning by India.
Another back foot punch by Aiden but he finds the cover fielder.
Kumar lands it on a good length on off, it's tapped off the back foot to covers.
Once again it's on a length around off, Markram punches it from the crease to covers and shouts nooooo.
Good length ball on off, Markram defends it off his back foot.
Off the mark first ball, Amla! Kumar offers width outside off, Hashim slaps it through covers and there is a sweeper in place, interestingly. A single results.

Back for the chase! Hashim Amla has a new partner in skipper Aiden Markram. South Africa need a solid beginning from this pair. For India, it's Bhuvneshwar Kumar to kickoff proceedings. A single slip in place. Here we go...
